g.text: Figure B. The two microstructure families: a two-phase continuum composite (two material variants, B1 and B2, on one mesh) and a structurally different periodic truss lattice (TL1).

g.text: All fields are actual MOOSE results at the offset yield point (B1/B2: whole-cell eqps = 1e-4; TL1: Levin macroscopic plastic strain = 1e-4).
